odia: ପୀଢ଼ା ଫାଟେ ନାହି ଲେଉଟେ ତେବେ ସେ ବ୍ରାହ୍ମଣ ଠାଆରୁ ଉଠ
title: A meal stretched into a taunt
literal_meaning: Provisional reading: The stool cracks, the navel turns out—only then, Brahmin, rise from your place.
explanation: Cracking furniture and the protruding navel exaggerate a meal into a caste-directed taunt. The final “rise” is retained as an apparent command, rather than silently made a report of what someone did. Our critical reading notices how bodily excess is attached to a named group; it rejects that attachment as evidence of the group’s conduct.
meaning_odia: ଫାଟୁଥିବା ପୀଢ଼ା ଓ ବାହାରୁଥିବା ନାହି ଭୋଜନକୁ ବଢ଼ାଇ ଏକ ଜାତି ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟରେ ଖୋଚା କରେ। ଶେଷର “ଉଠ”କୁ ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ଆଦେଶ ଭାବେ ରଖାଯାଇଛି; କିଏ କଣ କଲା ବୋଲି ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନାକୁ ବଦଳାଯାଇନାହିଁ। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାତ୍ମକ ପଢ଼ା ଦେଖେ କିପରି ଦେହର ଅତିଶୟତା ଏକ ନାମିତ ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀ ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଏ; ଏହାକୁ ସେ ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀର ଆଚରଣର ପ୍ରମାଣ ମାନେନାହିଁ।
english_summary: Our critical reading questions a caste stereotype carried by exaggerated eating.
odia_summary: ଅତିଶୟ ଭୋଜନର ଛବିରେ ଜାତିଗତ ଧାରଣାକୁ ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରେ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠ ଆଲୋଚନାରେ ଜଣେ ପୀଢ଼ା ଫାଟିବାର ଛବିରେ ହସିଲେ। ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ ପଚାରିଲେ, “ଅତିଶୟତାରେ ହସିବା ଓ ଗୋଟିଏ ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀକୁ ସେପରି ଭାବିବା ଏକା କଥା କି?” / In a reading discussion, someone laughs at the cracking stool. Another asks, “Is laughing at an exaggeration the same as believing it about a whole group?” This critical exchange is invented.
cultural_context: The source’s bodily gloss explains the image, not a diagnosis. Exact ending syntax remains elliptical; no historical meal, actual person, dietary instruction or customary group behaviour is established.
